title: One-step work-tape cell update
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $w$ be a finite bit string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $w$. For each work tape $\tau$ and integer cell position $z$, the indicator that the head on tape $\tau$ is at $z$ after one step equals the cell-head rule applied to the current snapshot and the indicators that the head was at $z-1$, $z$, and $z+1$. Also, the content of cell $z$ on tape $\tau$ after one step equals the cell-content rule applied to the current snapshot, the indicator that the head was at $z$, and the cell's current content.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the binary alphabet
